authority: Pre-launch audit after TARGET_PROJECTION_AMENDMENT recollection: GUARD vs BREACH separate strongly on role occupancy (L1=1.30; GUARD dominates one_attack_three_defend/turtle; BREACH dominates escort_pair), but f*=(n_att,n_def,adr) is nearly identical (~0.7/3.3/0.17) and slightly reversed. Soft q from (n_att,n_def) alone cannot express escort_pair. Keeping MSE would push both specialists toward the same f* and fight the CE term.

AMENDMENT.L_role: CE(p*_style, q_soft) ONLY. MSE(f_soft, f*) is dropped for this rung because f* does not separate the styles under the frozen collection. f* remains recorded in role_targets.json for audit/telemetry but is not a training term.
AMENDMENT.q_soft: Temperature-smoothed distribution over the existing 7 role_bucket labels. Allocation prototypes still use soft (n_att, n_def) from MacroAction probabilities. escort_pair / intercept_pair scores are boosted from PPO-batch global_state carrier features already in the buffer (red_flag_captured=blue carrying; blue_flag_captured=red carrying; carrier_teammate_support) — no new metric vocabulary.

WHY_STILL_ROLE_PRESERVATION: The capture-motivated distinction is team-level role occupancy (GUARD allocation/turtle vs BREACH escort), not local action JSD and not other-pole payoff. CE on frozen p* is exactly that axis.
TIMING_INTEGRITY: Zero training seeds and zero sealed crossover seeds spent at amendment time.
